qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base of minerals processing flowsheet equipment creates an aftermarket service anchor, but returns have been diluted by cyclical original equipment pricing, lumpiness, and historical EPC project execution, keeping multi-cycle GAAP ROIC well below 12%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power). FLSmidth has successfully transformed into a pure-play mining flowsheet and aftermarket provider by divesting its cement division, but multi-cycle GAAP ROIC has averaged just 3-6% over the last five years, failing the 12% hurdle. Returns are not suppressed by a temporary calamity but by structural capital intensity, acquisition goodwill, and cyclical mining capex exposure.
qualitative.evidence: Consolidated GAAP ROIC ranged between 2.3% and 5.6% from 2022 to 2024, rising toward ~9% in 2025 on continuing operations post-cement carveout. Group EBIT margins averaged 5-9% prior to 2025. While mining service revenues account for over 60% of continuing sales, large past acquisitions (TK Mining for €325m) and competitive pressure in capital equipment have kept multi-cycle returns well below cost of capital.
